ruleDefinitions.name: Potential WinAPI Calls Via CommandLine
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of WinAPI Functions via the commandline. As seen used by threat actors via the tool winapiexec

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*AddSecurityPackage.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*AdjustTokenPrivileges.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Advapi32.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*CloseHandle.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*CreateProcessWithToken.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*CreatePseudoConsole.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*CreateRemoteThread.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*CreateThread.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*CreateUserThread.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*DangerousGetHandle.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*DuplicateTokenEx.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*EnumerateSecurityPackages.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*FreeHGlobal.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*FreeLibrary.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*GetDelegateForFunctionPointer.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*GetLogonSessionData.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*GetModuleHandle.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*GetProcAddress.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*GetProcessHandle.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*GetTokenInformation.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*ImpersonateLoggedOnUser.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*kernel32.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*LoadLibrary.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*memcpy.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*MiniDumpWriteDump.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*ntdll.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*OpenDesktop.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*OpenProcess.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*OpenProcessToken.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*OpenThreadToken.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*OpenWindowStation.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*PtrToString.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*QueueUserApc.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*ReadProcessMemory.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*RevertToSelf.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*RtlCreateUserThread.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*secur32.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*SetThreadToken.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*VirtualAlloc.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*VirtualFree.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*VirtualProtect.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*WaitForSingleObject.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*WriteInt32.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*WriteProcessMemory.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*ZeroFreeGlobalAllocUnicode.*")) AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("\\\\MpCmdRun\\\.exe$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*GetLoadLibraryWAddress32.*")) OR (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\CompatTelRunner\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*FreeHGlobal.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*PtrToString.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*kernel32.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*CloseHandle.*"))))
